title: Completion: Sentences, Summaries, Notes, Tables and Flow-charts

rows: 60 minutes; three reading passages; 40 questions. All answers must be completed within the 60 minutes; there is no separate transfer time.
Read for the overall topic and paragraph main ideas.
Locate facts by names, dates, terms and paraphrases.
Compare question claims with the precise meaning of passage evidence.
Recognise the same ideas expressed using different vocabulary or grammar.
Identify the writer’s views or claims.
Identify the main idea of a paragraph.
Locate details or connect statements with named entities.
Sentence / Summary / Note / Table / Flow-chart Completion
Locate precise information, observe instructions and word limits.
Find precise details and match features to diagram labels.

theory.text: Fill gaps using words from the passage or a word list, as the instructions specify. Check the word limit, spelling and grammar. For flow-charts, follow the order of process stages.
Key skills: Predicting word class, locating evidence and checking exact wording.

guide.text: Read the instructions  inspect the gaps and surrounding words  predict the information needed  locate paraphrases  copy the correct word(s) or select from the list  check the limit and grammar.

small.text: Text: “The seeds are dried for 48 hours before being stored in glass containers.”
Complete using NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the text.E1. The drying stage lasts _____.E2. The seeds are stored in _____.

full.text: Paper is collected from offices and households. At the sorting centre, unsuitable material such as plastic is removed. The remaining paper is mixed with water to form pulp. Ink is then removed, and the cleaned pulp is pressed into sheets. Finally, the sheets are dried before packaging.
Complete using NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the passage.1. Paper is collected from offices and _____.2. Paper and water form _____.3. Cleaned pulp is pressed into _____ before drying.

Complete using NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the passage.Paper is collected from offices and (1) _____. At a sorting centre, unsuitable materials such as (2) _____ are removed. The paper is mixed with water to produce (3) _____.
Complete the process using NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the passage.

rows: Sorting and removal of unsuitable material
Pressing into sheets, drying and packaging
